scope: Randomized variants of the Mage reference requests against 2 and 5 targets, and of the Fire and Frostfire builds with a multidot against 3 and 4, all with area lines (validation/2026-10-06-mage-multi-target-sweep/*.base.json), 30 for each base at 200 iterations, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. The sweep sets every copy of the boss to the variant's level, so the targets stay identical, and draws each variant's race.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-06-mage-multi-target-sweep/SPEC.base.json --seed 20261006 --count 30 --iterations 200 --races RaceHuman,RaceGnome,RaceUndead,RaceTroll,RaceOrc,RaceHighOrderSkyborne --output <scratch>/SPEC for each base; each variant <scratch>/SPEC/sweep-XX.json is compared as SPEC-sweep-XX.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants renamed as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every request matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log.
